name: inspira-bento-grid
blurb: Flexible bento layout with icon cards and text reveals on hover.
description: A grid layout system with BentoGrid container, BentoGridCard items (with icon, title, description, CTA), and BentoGridItem for custom layouts. Cards scale and reveal CTAs on hover.
use_when: Product feature showcases or capability matrices where varied card sizes and icon-led hierarchy organize complex information.
avoid_when: Content-light or minimal designs where bento layout complexity might be unnecessary.
a11y: Cards are semantic containers with heading hierarchy. Icons paired with text. CTA links are keyboard accessible.
